title: Oozy Ukrainian Grain Pilaf
description: A jammy and cheesy Ukrainian dish featuring mixed grain and braise, perfect for a crowd, this pilaf is an ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly option that combines the best of grains and cheese for a delightful meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced mushroom and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the grated carrot and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked mixed grain, vegetable broth, tomato paste, salt, and black pepper, and stir until the grain is well coated.
Add the cooked onion, mushroom, and carrot mixture to the grain mixture and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with shredded mozzarella cheese.
Dot the top of the cheese with the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
